entities.name: MamS (Q6NE49)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Magnetospirillum gryphiswaldense magnetosome protein MamS; annotated to magnetosome membrane as a single-pass membrane protein.
MamS may play a role in magnetite crystal growth and size; sequence contains MamS_MamX domain PF26390.1 at residues 81–165.
